Brand pick: three comps

in review 2026-10-23 · feature brand-init · tier small · round 1

TL;DR

Three brand comps came back, and every one scored under the 7.5 taste bar (7.1, 7.2, 7.3). All three fail AA contrast in both themes, so each needs a token pass whichever you pick. Nothing was redrawn for sameness, and no lane failed.

I would pick comp 1, Lull. It is the only comp with no P0 and a motion PASS, and its faults are token fixes (border contrast, muted-on-accent) rather than a broken section; comp 3 has a P0 where its dark primitives strip renders empty, and comp 2 fails motion.

Comps

Comp 1: Lull taste 7.1

Taste 7.1 (design 7, usability 8, creativity 6.5, content 6.5). Under the 7.5 bar. Printed as scored. Not redrawn for sameness.

Motion: PASSAA contrast: light fail, dark fail
Live comp
Taste notes

Under the 7.5 bar and not rounded up. Scored from screenshots; the taste inspector was not run. Three rounds: the h1 moved out of the nav rail and now spans about 75% of the desktop width; one hero block serves phone and desktop; a scrim and balanced text fixed collisions and orphans. Still weak: the hero photo is a generic picsum fog and lake (creativity capped near 7), the wordmark appears twice, the top 45% of the desktop hero is empty fog, the hero has no live element, and the page credits Unsplash photographers while the photos come from picsum, so licence needs checking before launch.

Impeccable findings (11)
  • P1 Light: muted-foreground on accent is 3.55:1, below AA 4.5:1 (event sub-lines on tan blocks). Muted on card is 4.58:1, almost no margin.
  • P1 Borders and input outlines are far below 3:1. Light border 1.2-1.3:1, input 1.4-1.6:1; dark 1.4-1.7:1. Inputs, buttons, outline badges and checkboxes read as borderless.
  • P2 Dashboard hierarchy is flat; the paused video is the biggest object but carries no content.
  • P2 Dashboard surfaces collapse into one tone; the tan accent means selected, event and video placeholder at once.
  • P2 Now-playing card has dead space; sidebar is empty between Settings and Session; columns unbalanced.
  • P2 Primitives strip: cells sized to the tallest neighbour, 90-100px of empty card, dialog leaves 800px empty width.
  • P2 Disabled 'Saving' button is under 2:1 and reads as a ghost; no spinner to show loading.
  • P3 Strikethrough plus muted text makes done rows hard to read.
  • P3 Overdue marker 14:12 sits in the list with no gap; 'now' is the same red as destructive and error.
  • P3 Dark dashboard has the same flat-tone problem (dark text contrast passes).
  • P3 Mobile: sidebar collapses to a bare bar with an unlabelled pill; table wraps a task name across four lines at 390px.
Motion verdict: PASS

Judged from a read of comp.html with emil-design-eng rules; not rendered. Strong ease-out and ease-in-out curves, no ease-in, no transition:all, no scale(0). 140ms and 240ms UI durations; press feedback by scale; hover gated by hover:hover; reduced motion collapses all durations and forces reveals visible. Minor: toast entry is 600ms (use 240ms); toast uses keyframes; .row.live:hover is not gated; theme toggle fade is 600ms.

Comp 2: lull taste 7.2

Taste 7.2 (design 6.5, usability 8, creativity 7.5, content 7). Under the 7.5 bar. Printed as scored. Not redrawn for sameness.

Motion: FAILAA contrast: light fail, dark fail
Live comp
Taste notes

Under the 7.5 bar and not rounded up. Two rounds, screenshots only (no inspector). The hero was rebuilt: left-aligned headline at 17vw, lede 40px under it, straight stacked control cards on the right, buttons bottom-left. Still weak: dead zone at bottom right of the desktop hero; at extreme slider settings the B of ONE TAB. touches the Capitals card; no real picture, which caps design at 6.5; the slider idea (weight, tracking, case) could be copied; the control cards are 1px-bordered boxes, banned outside a data-ui fragment, but they carry data-ui.

Impeccable findings (10)
  • P1 Light: input and ghost-button borders are about 1.34:1 against background and 1.40:1 against card; WCAG 1.4.11 asks 3:1.
  • P1 Small text in --primary on near-white is 3.07:1 and fails 4.5:1 (slider values, Off label, Overdue badge, Today and Pink accents). Dark passes at 6.21:1.
  • P2 Dark: --border (10% white) is 2.72-2.89:1; cards and shell dissolve into the page.
  • P2 Dashboard video panel is placeholder art (flat pink rectangle, circle, pale box); reads as a wireframe.
  • P2 Dashboard hierarchy is flat; type about 10-12px at 1440; the Focus 25:00 pill is the only live status and it is badge sized.
  • P2 Dead space in Today card and sidebar; This-week cells about 40px wide; mismatched chips in the Thu cell.
  • P2 Primitives strip: disabled button reads as a faded second primary; unbalanced 3-column grid; heavy dark shadows glow muddily.
  • P2 Mobile: This-week strip cuts off Thursday with no scroll cue; Badge card has 80px empty space; Capitals toggle at awkward half width.
  • P3 Muted text and chips about 10px; raise secondary text to at least 12px.
  • P3 impeccable:impeccable could not be loaded (Unknown skill); the critique was done by reading the screenshots, not by running that skill.
Motion verdict: FAIL

Mostly sound, but the reduced-motion block misses the toast, so the 24px translateY slide (200ms) still plays. Fix: add .toast{transform:none} and keep the opacity fade. Passes on easing (strong ease-out, no ease-in, no transition:all), duration (120ms and 200ms), purpose, and hover gating. Optional: .sw::after slide under reduce, and .eq animates height instead of scaleY.

Comp 3: stint taste 7.3

Taste 7.3 (design 7.3, usability 7.8, creativity 6.8, content 7.5). Under the 7.5 bar. Printed as scored. Not redrawn for sameness.

Motion: PASSAA contrast: light fail, dark fail
Live comp
Taste notes

Under the 7.5 bar and not rounded up. Two rounds on the hero only; screenshots only (no inspector); the full-page shots below the hero were not examined. Hero copy block now sits 40px under a headline of up to 16vw; the arch picture is bigger; the clock moved into the black band. Still weak: the hero picture is a grayscale picsum lake and mountains, generic, fails the competitor test, with no credit; the hero shows no product fragment; mobile has empty green beside the arch; desktop margins are unequal (60px right, 28px left); dark mode barely changes the hero; lower-page issues were not touched.

Impeccable findings (9)
  • P0 Dark: the whole 'small parts.' primitives strip renders as an empty black void about 1000px tall at 1440, with no heading and no tiles; mobile dark shows the same gap. Probably a reveal animation that never fires in a full-page capture, or a dark colour clash. Primitives cannot be judged in dark.
  • P1 Borders fail 3:1. Light border is 1.53:1 on white, 1.40:1 on card; dark about 1.5:1 as browsers blend it.
  • P1 Mobile dashboard tab bar is clipped at the right edge (Settings unreachable, no scroll hint).
  • P2 Desktop dashboard reads as a thumbnail: 10-12px text on a 1440 canvas, dead margins, half-empty Tasks column.
  • P2 Light dashboard has weak figure/ground and three loud accents (lime, black Pause, orange event); calendar blocks overlap.
  • P2 Primitives sit on saturated flat tiles, not the real background and card surfaces; uneven tile heights.
  • P3 Micro type 11-13px; scale jumps from huge display to micro with no middle step.
  • P3 No tabular figures; the 24:14 timer shifts as digits change.
  • P3 Toast and its trigger button are near-identical dark bars; Skip, Later and Add task are close in weight; chart-2 on card is 1.7:1 in light.
Motion verdict: PASS

Read-only review against emil-design-eng; no P0/P1. Strong ease-out and ease-in-out curves, no ease-in, no transition:all; 140ms and 220ms UI durations; dialog starts at scale(0.96) with @starting-style; hover gated. Reduced motion mostly collapses. Gaps: .btn:hover translateY(-2px) and .ev:hover translateX(3px) are not neutralised, .box svg scale(0.8) and .task:active scale(.99) still run, and reveal stagger delay stays under reduce.
